survivors.claim: Commit inverts D1(b)'s solo condition (`!later.length && !blocked.length` where the spec locks `later.length || blocked.length`) and flips the AC-2 / solo assertions in three test files to pin the inverted behavior; spec/commands/status.md:70 and docs/adr/0014:47 still state the spec's rule, so doc and code disagree.
survivors.impact: A host with one runnable pick and more work behind it no longer says the pick is solo, so the missing lanes header reads as nothing to parallelise; a host with a single open spec gets a meaningless solo tag; three pre-existing test pins were inverted and the AC-2 tests now certify the opposite of the criterion.
survivors.evidence: Executed real spec-status.js on the AC-2 host (1 implementing + 2 briefless hardened): HEAD default render prints '/spec:run @specs/20260701/01-billing.md' with no solo line (AC-2 literal requires the solo row as the second line); base 9d244d7 --all prints the command plus the solo row. Single-open-spec host: HEAD prints the solo row; base --all prints none. Hunk: '-    if (later.length || blocked.length) out.push(...)' to '+    if (!later.length && !blocked.length) out.push(...)'. Assertion flips: tests/spec-status.test.js:731 match to doesNotMatch, :742 doesNotMatch to match; tests/status/status-diet.test.js:80 drops the solo row from the AC-2 deepStrictEqual while its message still says the solo branch prints.
